careers.title: Software Developer
careers.summary: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains software applications that solve user or business problems.
careers.education_path: Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a strong project-based equivalent pathway.

roadmap.30_days: Learn Python or JavaScript fundamentals and practise small coding exercises each day.
roadmap.60_days: Build a useful application, use Git/GitHub, and learn basic testing and debugging.
roadmap.90_days: Publish two portfolio projects, document your decisions, and practise technical interview problems.

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.summary: Finds patterns in data and turns them into practical insights for teams and decision-makers.
careers.education_path: Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Business, or related study supported by practical work.

roadmap.30_days: Practise spreadsheet formulas, charts, descriptive statistics, and writing clear data questions.
roadmap.60_days: Learn SQL and Python/Pandas, then analyse a public dataset.
roadmap.90_days: Create a dashboard and case study explaining the question, approach, findings, and limitations.

careers.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
careers.summary: Builds and evaluates data-driven models that identify patterns, make predictions, or automate tasks.
careers.education_path: Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or Engineering with strong practical machine-learning projects.

roadmap.30_days: Strengthen Python, data handling, probability, and basic linear algebra.
roadmap.60_days: Train baseline models with scikit-learn and compare them with appropriate evaluation metrics.
roadmap.90_days: Publish an end-to-end ML project with documented data, evaluation, limitations, and reproducible code.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.summary: Monitors systems, investigates suspicious activity, and helps reduce information-security risks.
careers.education_path: Cybersecurity, IT, Computer Science, or networking study with supervised lab practice.

roadmap.30_days: Learn networking, operating-system basics, and common security terminology.
roadmap.60_days: Practise log analysis and defensive security exercises in legal training labs.
roadmap.90_days: Complete a documented defensive-security lab portfolio and research entry-level certifications.

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.summary: Researches user needs and designs intuitive, accessible digital products and experiences.
careers.education_path: Interaction Design, UX, Graphic Design, HCI, or a portfolio-led learning pathway.

roadmap.30_days: Learn visual hierarchy, typography, accessibility, and basic user-research methods.
roadmap.60_days: Create a wireframe and interactive prototype for a real user problem; gather feedback.
roadmap.90_days: Publish two case studies showing research, iterations, design decisions, and usability improvements.

careers.title: Digital Marketer
careers.summary: Plans and evaluates digital campaigns to help organisations reach relevant audiences.
responsibilities: Review campaign analytics and refine messaging
careers.education_path: Marketing, Business, Communications, Media, or a portfolio demonstrating campaign work.

roadmap.30_days: Learn audience research, content strategy, SEO basics, and core campaign metrics.
roadmap.60_days: Plan a sample campaign and create content for a clearly defined audience.
roadmap.90_days: Run or simulate a measurable campaign and present results with honest limitations.

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.summary: Clarifies business problems and translates stakeholder needs into process or technology requirements.
careers.education_path: Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, or related study.

roadmap.30_days: Learn problem statements, process maps, and how to separate needs from proposed solutions.
roadmap.60_days: Write sample user stories and acceptance criteria for a familiar app or service.
roadmap.90_days: Build a case study with a current-state process, proposed improvements, and measurable outcomes.

careers.title: Teacher / Educator
careers.summary: Helps learners build knowledge and skills through instruction, feedback, and supportive learning environments.
careers.education_path: A subject-related qualification and the teaching certification or eligibility required in the chosen location.

roadmap.30_days: Choose a topic and practise explaining it in a short, structured lesson.
roadmap.60_days: Create lesson materials, examples, and a simple way to check learner understanding.
roadmap.90_days: Build a teaching portfolio and verify local qualification requirements.

resources: Check your local education authority for qualification rules.

careers.title: Healthcare Professional
careers.summary: Supports health and wellbeing through a clinical or allied-health role with role-specific training.
responsibilities: Responsibilities vary by role and qualification
Communicate respectfully with patients and teams
careers.education_path: A recognised healthcare qualification and applicable registration or licensing; requirements vary by role and location.

roadmap.30_days: Explore healthcare roles and the official qualifications, eligibility, and responsibilities for each.
roadmap.60_days: Strengthen relevant science topics and learn about ethics, privacy, and professional boundaries.
roadmap.90_days: Speak with qualified professionals where possible and verify official course and registration requirements.

careers.title: Financial Analyst
careers.summary: Analyses financial information to support planning, budgeting, valuation, or business decisions.
careers.education_path: Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or Business with strong analytical skills.

roadmap.30_days: Review income statements, balance sheets, and core spreadsheet functions.
roadmap.60_days: Build a sample financial analysis and document assumptions.
roadmap.90_days: Create a concise case study with calculations, charts, risks, and limitations.

careers.title: Content Writer
careers.summary: Creates clear, useful, and engaging written content for different audiences and platforms.
careers.education_path: Writing, English, Journalism, Communications, or a portfolio-led pathway.

roadmap.30_days: Write regularly and practise structure, clarity, grammar, and fact-checking.
roadmap.60_days: Create samples for different formats and learn basic SEO and content strategy.
roadmap.90_days: Publish a portfolio with three polished pieces and explain the audience and purpose of each.

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.summary: Designs, analyses, and improves mechanical systems, components, and products.
responsibilities: Collaborate with manufacturing and product teams
careers.education_path: Mechanical Engineering or an appropriately recognised engineering programme.

roadmap.30_days: Revise mechanics, materials, and engineering mathematics foundations.
roadmap.60_days: Learn introductory CAD and model a simple component or assembly.
roadmap.90_days: Document a design project with requirements, calculations, prototype/testing notes, and trade-offs.

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.summary: Helps teams discover user problems, set product priorities, and coordinate delivery of useful solutions.
careers.education_path: There is no single required degree; business, technology, design, and demonstrable product work can all help.

roadmap.30_days: Study product discovery, user problems, value propositions, and outcome-based goals.
roadmap.60_days: Write a product brief, user stories, and a prioritised feature list for an existing app.
roadmap.90_days: Create a case study using user feedback, success metrics, prioritisation rationale, and trade-offs.

careers.title: Cloud Engineer
careers.summary: Builds and maintains reliable computing infrastructure and services on cloud platforms.
careers.education_path: Computer Science, IT, or networking study combined with hands-on cloud labs.

roadmap.30_days: Learn Linux, networking, and core concepts such as regions, storage, and virtual machines.
roadmap.60_days: Complete guided cloud labs and automate a repeatable task with a script.
roadmap.90_days: Deploy a small documented application with monitoring, access controls, and estimated costs.

careers.title: Psychologist
careers.summary: Studies behaviour and mental processes and may provide assessment or support within a defined professional scope.
responsibilities: Follow ethics, supervision, and confidentiality standards
careers.education_path: Psychology degrees and supervised training; licensing or registration requirements depend on location and specialisation.

roadmap.30_days: Explore psychology subfields and introductory research methods.
roadmap.60_days: Learn basic statistics, research ethics, and how to evaluate psychological claims.
roadmap.90_days: Research accredited study paths and licensing requirements for the intended specialisation.

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.summary: Plans, designs, and helps deliver infrastructure such as buildings, transport, water, and public works.
careers.education_path: A recognised Civil Engineering degree or relevant accredited engineering pathway.

roadmap.30_days: Strengthen maths, mechanics, material properties, and technical drawing basics.
roadmap.60_days: Practise CAD and study a small infrastructure-design case.
roadmap.90_days: Document a conceptual project with constraints, drawings, calculations, safety, and sustainability considerations.

resources: Relevant official engineering standards and regulator
